acceptance.output_evidence: RECORD, no verdict. ON 'GENUINELY RE-RUN': every re_derived entry's `how` quotes output produced by this run from the third position, and the instrument that produced it is committed (rederive_r1.py, subcommand `probes`, 78 probes in a tracked table) so the CVO can re-run any entry with one command and compare strings. Three artefacts of an actual run rather than a restatement are visible in the record: (i) a probe read ABSENT on its first needle because the needle copied the CITATION's spelling `kind="FORK"` while the file spells it `"kind": "FORK"` -- the wrong-object error is recorded in the instrument's own comment and in D1R1-AC3's qualifier, and a restated entry would not have one; (ii) R1R1-AC5 carries a NEGATIVE CONTROL that fired the wrong way first -- an enumerate of DEC-7 over the PRD returns 4 hits whose FIRST is :176, which reads like citation drift until the bytes at the cited :239-242 are printed and turn out to be the DEC-7 bullet; (iii) three arms came back FAIL from this position (e2-reproduce, x3-diff, x3-nontrivial) and are quoted as FAIL, which no restatement of a round-1 instance would produce, since all three fed PASS grades there. ON 'A MECHANISM CENSUS RATHER THAN THE HANDED LIST': the census is `rederive_r1.py mechanism`, an AST call-graph closure over check_lt_r1.py's 165 function definitions with the denominator taken from the checker's OWN SUBCOMMANDS table (67 arms) -- a DIFFERENT INSTRUMENT from S18's grep of one helper name, which is what makes its agreement corroboration rather than repetition. It reproduces {x2-flag, x3-filed} for the ambient-ref class exactly and goes beyond the handed list in three directions: x3-diff (a third _last_two() arm, FAIL-X3-COMMITTED-DIFF-REPRODUCES, in neither R2_BASE's four nor S18's evidence), x2-flag's second ambient limb (the git status --porcelain read), and x3-two-runs' shared-directory bar. The census's 11 flagged arms were then INSPECTED BY HAND and four were CLEARED as R-40 manifest-identity arms plus one as a heuristic false positive -- a list that only grows is not a census. Finally, the sightings were run after the census and found a class the static census cannot reach at all (LIVE-BUILDER DRIFT, e2-reproduce), which is filed as row LGIC_LGCTFM-W1-S21. WHAT THE ARMS CANNOT CHECK, stated plainly: they count fields and test substrings; they cannot tell whether the four criteria in not_re_derivable are the RIGHT four. The two judgment calls in that choice are declared: E2R1-AC5 is classified on the limb that cannot re-derive while its other limb can, and X3R1-AC5 is classified RE-DERIVED although three of its four arms are position-broken, because the claim addresses its evidence by run id rather than by position.
